create.name: Rochelle Schieck
create.bio:
Rochelle Schieck is the founder of Qoya Inspired Movement, a practice of dance, yoga-based movement and ritual built on the idea that each person's essence is wise, wild and free. Dance carried her through childhood, and she went on to take a degree in interdisciplinary arts focused on the effects of movement. She has since trained in many forms, among them hatha and vinyasa yoga, Nia, yoga nidra, energy healing and massage, and has studied nature mysticism with Q'ero paqos in Peru, travelling to more than thirty countries along the way.

A Qoya class moves through simple sequences to music, from shaking and stretching to free dance, with time for stillness, reflection and ritual. Rochelle teaches online and in person, leads retreats, and has certified Qoya teachers in many countries through a three-phase training. She also runs LORE, an online community for moving together every day, offers year-long one-to-one apprenticeships and mentorships, and combines movement with astrology in what she calls embodied astrology. Her book Qoya: A Compass for Navigating an Embodied Life that is Wise, Wild and Free blends memoir with practical exercises and has been translated into French and Spanish.

books.title: Qoya: A Compass for Navigating an Embodied Life that is Wise, Wild and Free
books.author: Rochelle Schieck
books.description: Rochelle's book on listening to the body as a guide, mixing stories from her own travels and pilgrimages with more than thirty exercises for readers to try.

courses.title: Intro to Qoya: Self-Paced Teacher Training
courses.description: The first of three phases of Qoya teacher training: more than ten hours online covering the thirteen pillars of Qoya, a full class, and a workbook for building a home practice. Later phases prepare people to teach others.

courses.title: Embodied Presence Yearlong Apprenticeship
courses.description: A year of one-to-one work with Rochelle for people who create experiences for others, with eleven two-hour sessions, eleven shorter check-ins and a personal plan of movement and earth-connection practices.

courses.title: Embodied Astrology Readings
courses.description: Birth-chart sessions in which Rochelle pairs an astrology reading with a personal movement ritual, so the themes of the chart are explored through the body as well as in words.

courses.title: LORE: Qoya Online Community
courses.description: An online membership for moving together through the year, with monthly themes, live sessions led by Rochelle and guest teachers, conversation, nature connection and ritual.

free_resources.title: Free Qoya Movement Videos
free_resources.description: A library of free movement rituals in five-, fifteen- and thirty-minute lengths, some with and some without music, for trying Qoya at home.
